# Native gem5 text fixtures

These fixtures are generated by the verbatim `ScalarPrint`, `VectorPrint` and `DistPrint` bodies at
gem5 commit `bb83b97b1f5f8bbc314f4320ed27c845e266f7bd`, using a small source-extracted C++ harness.
They are printer controls, not the result of a complete simulator build. Their spelling, default
precision, PDF/CDF and suppression behavior follow the pinned
[primary text printer](https://github.com/gem5/gem5/blob/bb83b97b1f5f8bbc314f4320ed27c845e266f7bd/src/base/stats/text.cc).

The fixtures cover integer, offset, non-unit, negative, nozero, oneline and empty Distribution
output, plus fractional and nonfinite Vector output with optional unit annotations. `empty_vector.txt` uses arbitrary Vector subnames to
reproduce `empty_dist.txt` exactly. The three nozero fixtures have distinct declared grids but
identical printed observations; text alone cannot recover the configured native grid.
